title: Screening and identification of a novel umami peptide with in vitro anti-inflammatory potential from sea cucumber protein: Integration of flavoromics, bioinformatic prediction, molecular simulation and experimental validation.
authors: Chu, Zhongxing; Long, Can; Xu, Kangjie; Zhang, Xingjing; Qin, Dandan; Hu, Zuomin; Zhou, Yaping; Luo, Feijun; Lin, Qinlu
one_liner_zh: 该文从海参蛋白水解物中筛选鲜味抗炎肽，虽涉及分子对接和动力学模拟，但核心对象是肽段而非蛋白质结构，且方法以风味组学和实验验证为主，结构计算仅作为辅助筛选工具，与蛋白质结构计算课题关联有限。
abstract: Sea cucumber protein was sequentially hydrolyzed with pepsin, trypsin, and enterokinase to obtain peptides with desirable taste characteristics and immunomodulatory potential. Multi-scale characterization, flavoromics, peptidomics, bioinformatic screening, molecular simulations, and cellular assays were employed to investigate the structural changes, flavor remodeling, and bioactivity of the resulting hydrolysates. Results showed that hydrolysis disrupted the compact protein structure, induced conformational unfolding, and yielded short peptides (0.5-1.5 kDa) with enhanced hydrophilicity and processing adaptability. The volatile profile was significantly reshaped, with marked enrichment of aldehydes and heterocyclic compounds. Through multi-dimensional screening, the pentapeptide FDRGF (TH) was identified with outstanding umami taste and low bitterness. Molecular docking and dynamics simulations confirmed stable binding of TH to immunomodulatory targets, and cellular assays verified that TH improved macrophage metabolic status and regulated the expression of inflammatory mediators under LPS-induced inflammatory conditions. This study elucidates the structure-flavor-activity relationships of sea cucumber protein hydrolysates and identifies a dual-function umami peptide with immunomodulatory activity, providing theoretical support for the value-added utilization of sea cucumber resources.
abstract_zh: 海参蛋白经胃蛋白酶、胰蛋白酶和肠激酶依次水解，获得具有理想呈味特性和免疫调节潜力的肽段。采用多尺度表征、风味组学、肽组学、生物信息学筛选、分子模拟及细胞实验，研究所得水解物的结构变化、风味重塑及生物活性。结果表明，水解破坏了致密的蛋白质结构，诱导构象展开，并产生具有增强亲水性和加工适应性的短肽（0.5-1.5 kDa）。挥发性特征显著重塑，醛类和杂环化合物明显富集。通过多维筛选，鉴定出五肽FDRGF（TH）具有突出的鲜味和低苦味。分子对接和动力学模拟证实TH与免疫调节靶点的稳定结合，细胞实验验证TH在脂多糖诱导的炎症条件下改善巨噬细胞代谢状态并调节炎症介质的表达。本研究阐明了海参蛋白水解物的结构-风味-活性关系，并鉴定出一种具有免疫调节活性的双功能鲜味肽，为海参资源的高值化利用提供理论支持。
